intro: The Woven Wand is a unique enchanted relic crafted long ago by three Dalaran apprentice magi as a pledge of brotherhood. Following the fall of Lordaeron and bitter betrayals among its creators, the wand was hidden away in Fenris Keep before resurfacing in the hands of the Forsaken.

p: In the days when Dalaran still trained the young magi of the north, three aspiring wizards—Bethor Iceshard, Gunther Arcanus, and Thule Ravenclaw—intertwined their individual apprentice wands into a single talisman. This Woven Wand served as both a conduit of combined magical power and a symbol of their enduring friendship. That fellowship shattered irrevocably when the Scourge swept through Lordaeron. Thule Ravenclaw chose to swear fealty to the Lich King, turning to foul necromancy. Meanwhile, the Plague of Undeath claimed both Bethor and Gunther, eventually cutting their ties to Dalaran entirely.
